title: Two to infinity norm bound
statement: Let $S=\{-1,1\}$ have the uniform probability distribution, and let $X(s)=s$. For every $a,b\in\mathbb{R}$, the uniform supremum norm of the constant function with value $a$ is at most the uniform $L^2$ norm of $a+bX$.
